# webtables/wasi

> Helper: the WASI runtime: Linux syscalls translated to WASI calls.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/wasi.pkg)

Included with `@wasi` by every package that talks to the system:
`$__pk_syscall` (used by [syscall](syscall.md)) pops the arguments and
dispatches on the Linux syscall number to `$__pk_sys`; `$__pk_rw` reads
or writes through `fd_read`/`fd_write` (also used by `print` and
panics); `$__pk_path` picks the preopened directory for a path;
`$__pk_errno` translates WASI error codes to negative Linux ones.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@alloc
```

Includes: [webtables/alloc](alloc.md)
